name: discord-web-search-nov-16
note: رسمي: Discord blog, 27 Oct 2026 'Making content from Discoverable Servers easier to discover': Server Web Pages for all Discoverable Servers from 16 Nov 2026; channel messages in web search from mid-December; usernames and avatars not shown; DMs, group DMs and private servers excluded; member setting on by default outside the EU, UK, Canada, Brazil, Australia and South Korea. Picture track: Discord's own six blog images framed whole over a blurred hero (storybeat.py), so no UI text is cut by a 9:16 crop. Our bed.
